description: 次世代自動車充電インフラビジョンの要件確認の状況 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 宮崎県. 電気自動車の充電インフラ等の整備にかかる申請件数、場所等. Coverage: 宮崎県. The portal files it under the publisher 宮崎県. Its tags are 地球温暖化. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-03-28 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
